usedFor: monday.com tracks the work and Google Drive keeps the files. When “New User Joins” fires in monday.com, “Create Folder” can set up a home in Drive for that person before they ask for one.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Joins” in monday.com, then “Create Folder” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Onboarding someone is the one-off moment a fresh folder helps, and “Create Folder” can place it inside a parent folder you pick, so every new user lands in the same structure.

watchOut: “New User Joins” is polling, so it checks on a schedule. The folder shows up a little after the person joins, not at that second.
